name: Shinsei Kourin S-TRAN[C]XE
original_name: 神聖昂燐エストランジェ
source:
In modern Japan, a sudden emergence of dangerous demon beasts has caused widespread fear and disruption. These creatures target females, and their bodily fluids are lethal when injected into humans. This crisis prompted the development of a technology to absorb and harness the energy of demon beasts, but it's highly unstable. To optimize this method and avoid wasting resources, researchers developed the S-TRAN(C)XE System, also known as the Succubusystem, which can repurpose absorbed energy into an enhanced suit. During the system's first human trial, the research facility was attacked by demon beasts, leading to chaos and the death of a girl. However, she later awakens as an S-TRAN(C)XE, a hunter of demon beasts.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.chaos-r.com/chr021/index.php]official site[/url]]
translation:
在现代日本，突然出现的危险妖兽引起了广泛的恐惧和混乱。这些生物以雌性为目标，它们的体液注射到人类体内是致命的。这场危机促使一种吸收和利用妖兽能量的技术得以发展，但它非常不稳定。为了优化这种方法并避免浪费资源，研究人员开发了S-TRAN(C)XE系统，也称为Succubu系统，它可以将吸收的能量重新利用到增强型套装中。在系统第一次人体试验中，研究设施遭到妖兽袭击，导致一片混乱，并导致一名女孩死亡。然而，她后来觉醒为S-TRAN(C)XE，一名妖兽猎人。

[翻译自[url=http://www.chaos-r.com/chr021/index.php]官方网站[/url]]
